title: Root sessions: an interrupted Codex tool process tree can outlive the turn under the shared app-server
outcome: Root sessions: an interrupted Codex tool process tree can outlive the turn under the shared app-server
acceptance: A concrete root-session orphan is observed and recorded with its process tree, or the class is shown not to occur; if it occurs, an interrupted root turn leaves no tool process running, shown by a behaviour test without timing thresholds on Linux and Windows.
